confidence_notes: The FX figure is the RBA observation for 2026-11-18, found via one search of RBA pages. Food and drink anchors come from one search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living sources, which gave wide ranges for Tulum depending on whether the venue is in town or on the beach. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are blended town and tourist-zone prices. I found no direct wine-by-the-glass price, so wine is set from the cocktail and beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no searches or listings checked. They are the least certain and are very seasonal and location-dependent.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tulum is priced well above typical Mexico, closer to Playa del Carmen and Cancun tourist zones, with the beach-zone premium partly blended in.
